name: verification-method-picker
title: Verification method picker
description: The 'try another way' step of two-step sign-in: authenticator, security key, text message or recovery code, each with a line on what happens.
docs: methods is { id, label, description, icon?, unavailableReason? }[]. lastUsed marks one with Last used and chooses it first (value and onValueChange control the choice, defaultValue sets the first one); a method with an unavailableReason stays on the list, disabled, with the reason in text under its name at full contrast rather than faded away with the card. It is a real radio group, so the arrow keys move and choose and skip disabled methods, but choosing never submits: onContinue(id) runs only when Continue is pressed, so a stray keypress can never send a text message. While it runs the button keeps the focus and shows a spinner; a returned message, or a throw, shows above the button and the choice stays. When nothing can be used a notice says so and Continue stays quiet, and a choice that has become unavailable since the card opened counts as no choice. onBack adds a Back button, help sits under Continue (a link to a recovery code, to support), and titleAs and labels as in the other cards.
